chunks: From him, from ʿAlī ibn Asbāṭ, from his uncle Yaʿqūb ibn Sālim al-Aḥmar, from Abī Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
If she becomes pure at night from her menstruation, then delays performing ghusl in Ramadan until morning comes, then making up that day is upon her.

key_terms.أَصْبَحَتْ: morning came upon her; dawn arrived
key_terms.رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramadan in which fasting is obligatory
key_terms.قَضَاءُ: make-up performance of an omitted obligatory fast

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a woman becomes pure from menstruation at night in Ramadan but does not perform ghusl before dawn?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman who becomes pure from hayd during the night in Ramadan but delays ghusl until dawn. It states that she must perform qada' of that day's fast, highlighting the importance of ritual purity at the start of the fasting day.
